87a7b372472f4eefa4a5240a description: Unusual transport, you say? Hm... Lucky you. Very lucky. I do need something, pronto, so we have a deal. Bring me a few military power filters, and I'll sort out transport for you. What kind of transport you're looking for? I don't give a damn. My helicopter can get you anywhere, as long as it's not out of Tarkov. Yes, I have a helicopter. I've got a lotta things. But until you bring me those filters, I'm not even thinking about your request.
87a7b372472f4eefa4a5240a startedMessageT: Three military power filters, fresh from the field. No filters, no rotors.
87a7b372472f4eefa4a5240a successMessageT: Hand them over to my guys on the way out. So now you want to talk about the helicopter? Alright, we can talk. First, it needs maintenance. And no, I'm not letting you anywhere near a machine like that. What, you want me to send you a beer to your hideout so you don't get bored? No chance, rookie!
87a7b372472f4eefa4a5240a failMessageText: No filters, no helicopter. Simple arithmetic.
1734b85b9623f60d7d4e5896: Hand over 3 Military power filters to Prapor
6ae67821fba98a599d75d6b6 description: The bird needs maintenance before it flies anywhere, and that means proper fluids. Check the Reserve base. You'll need aviation oil, called AMG-10. It's stored in canisters or special containers. The army kept aviation supplies around their vehicle depots and warehouses, so start there. Bring the canister back in one piece and we're another step closer to your ride.
6ae67821fba98a599d75d6b6 startedMessageT: AMG-10, Reserve base. Canisters or special containers. Don't come back with engine oil, rookie.
6ae67821fba98a599d75d6b6 successMessageT: Ah, it's you. Leave it by the entrance. I'll have the boys prep the bird. When do we fly? Here's the situation... I talked to the pilots. I'll be straight with you: they're not flying to some unknown ship. You'll get the chopper, but only for extraction from the ship. To get in, you'll have to figure something else out. Too risky. There's no telling who's dug in on that ship. I could lose the bird, crew included. And I don't have spare pilots. So, you taking the heli or not? Then listen up. The chopper can only pick you up from a proper landing zone. Hope your ship's got one. Clear it, pop a signal flare, and the bird will come in. One more thing. Don't forget to bring cash. Every flight costs money.
6ae67821fba98a599d75d6b6 failMessageText: No oil, no maintenance. No maintenance, no helicopter.
c145e5b75c3e56f82cbbb25b: Locate the AMG-10 hydraulic fluid on Reserve
